props.name: children
props.comment: The filter inputs (`useInput`-driven) whose values drive `setFilters`.

props.name: debounce
props.comment:
ADVISORY debounce (ms) for API parity with ra. The EFFECTIVE debounce is
the list controller's own `debounceMs` — FilterLiveForm delegates it and
does not add a form-side timer.

props.name: resource
props.comment: Overrides the ambient resource (drives the filter-flavored labels).
